full/acta2.csv.description: r of ACTA2 with every gene per niche, and whether the gene is in ACTA2's block

full/blocks.csv.description: one row per niche x block: genes, hubs, within / between / null mean |r|, null_p, co-varying, enrichment

full/cells_niche.npz.description: every cell: x, y, its tile's niche (-1 = none)

full/corr_niche0.npy.description: niche 0's mean correlation in its gene order (float32)

full/corr_niche1.npy.description: niche 1's mean correlation in its gene order (float32)

full/corr_niche2.npy.description: niche 2's mean correlation in its gene order (float32)

full/enrich_null.csv.description: expected enriched fraction of random gene sets per block size

full/layout.json.description: gene order and blocks per niche, panel genes

full/niche_types.csv.description: annotated cell types of each niche's index-tile cells vs the section

seed0/example.csv.description: the example whole-tile query (rule in programs.py): compositions of query, Spindle's top 10, random 10, section, Spindle's top 5, random 5

seed0/example_cells.npz.description: cells (x, y, class) and boxes of the example query and Spindle's top 10

seed0/tile_queries.csv.description: one row per held-out tile: class composition, TV to Spindle's top 10 / top 5, random 10 / random 5, Spindle-naive's top 10 / top 5; Spindle's overlap with Spindle-naive's 10, tiles returned
